reviewNotes:
Version 1.3 (build 21) adds Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean throughout the app, including calculator labels, materials, settings, purchase UI, validation messages and customer PDF quotes. App and quote languages are independent. New projects default to the selected app language, or the supported system language. Backup and restore preserve all five supported language choices.

To review: open Settings > App language and select 繁體中文, 日本語 or 한국어. Alternatively set the device language before launching. Create a project and check Quote language, or edit an existing project to select a different quote language. Add a valid calculation, then open Quote preview and export a PDF.

No demo account is required. Core calculations work offline. SteelFlow Pro is a non-consumable lifetime purchase (com.steelflow.app.pro.lifetime), not a subscription. Open Settings > SteelFlow Pro to purchase or restore using the same Apple Account. Project data stays on the device; RevenueCat processes anonymous purchase and entitlement information.

pricing.note: Use territory-specific App Store price points; do not auto-convert from one base currency.
